title: observability: token-level KV cache hit/miss metrics, dashboard panels, and alert tuning
author: Sara Kim
description:
Motivation: improve observability for KV-cache behavior at token granularity to help diagnose token-level latency/cost regressions and to enable more targeted alerting. Existing metrics exposed cache hits at request-level which hides pathological prefix-sharing and tiny-cache-miss patterns that drive high per-token compute cost.

What this PR does:
- Adds token-level KV cache hit/miss counters and ratios emitted per model/route/host.
- Adds histogram of per-token latency split by cache hit vs miss to help quantify cost impact.
- Adds new Grafana dashboard panels (token-level cache hit rate, per-token latency by hit/miss, hot-prefix heatmap) and updates the existing cost/latency dashboard to include a token-breakdown row.
- Introduces tuned alerting rules: high token-miss-rate for a model-route (warning/critical), sustained increase in per-token latency for cache-miss paths, and a new low-cache-hit anomaly detection rule for sudden drops.
- Feature gated behind runtime config flag `enable_token_kv_metrics` (default off) and rollout controlled via feature flags to avoid high cardinality in older clusters.

Implementation notes:
- Instrumentation added in the serving runtime path where KV lookup occurs: lightweight atomic counters per request thread aggregated at flush intervals to avoid per-token allocation pressure. Exported via our Prometheus metrics endpoint in new metric families: `redwood_kv_token_hits_total`, `redwood_kv_token_misses_total`, `redwood_kv_token_latency_seconds_bucket{hit="true|false"}`.
- To reduce label-cardinality we limit label set to `model`, `route`, and `host_region`. `route` is truncated to the first 64 characters; unknown routes are grouped under `_unknown`.
- Added aggregation helpers in observability-pack for building the dashboard panels and alerting rules.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add counters and histograms in runtime
- [x] Add feature flag and rollout plan
- [x] Add dashboard panels and JSON model for Grafana
- [x] Add alerting rules and escalation notes
- [x] Update docs (observability/metrics.md) with metric names and examples
- [x] Add unit tests for metric emission and integration test for Prom endpoint

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests cover emission logic and label sanitization.
- Integration test asserts Prom metrics endpoint returns new metric families when feature flag enabled.
- Local load test (1k concurrent streams) validated metric aggregation overhead < 2% CPU and memory overhead < 50MB on a p4d instance with synthetic traffic.
- Canary rollout: enabled in internal staging for 48h with targeted routes; dashboards validated by SRE.

Rollout notes:
- Feature flag required to be toggled on for Dedicated clusters. Private installer includes new package `obs-metrics` that optionally enables this by default for customers wanting token-level granularity.
- Warn customers in release notes about potential high-cardinality if they configure custom routing labels.

Related: Linear ENG-4521, ENG-4550. Related PRs: pr-42789 (observability-kv-token-metrics...), pr-43012 (perf: batching telemetry).
